data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2014 gross claims outstanding were GBP 231.724m. During 2014 there was an overall favourable movement on prior year reserves of GBP 1.922m (a release), principally driven by a GBP 5.89m improvement on reinsurance acceptances, partially offset by adverse development in Marine ( GBP 1.621m) and Property (Fire and other damage to property GBP 2.094m). The net effect was a small release versus opening reserves.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year movement is taken from the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note which provides an overall improvement figure (GBP 1,922k) and component movements. The note is presented as narrative; amounts are treated as GROSS per the note's context. A small arithmetic difference exists between the sum of the component movements and the stated overall improvement (likely rounding or additional minor items). No gross claims development triangle was found in the disclosed pages, so triangle-based cross-checks are not available.
